lines.text: There's a reason most interfaces barely move: animation lives in a different file. Jumi puts it back in your markup.
lines.say: There's a reason most interfaces barely move: animation lives in a different file. Joomi puts it back in your markup.

lines.text: Tailwind already gives you a class for everything else. With Jumi, motion is one more class, and its timing sits right next to it.
lines.say: Tailwind already gives you a class for everything else. With Joomi, motion is one more class, and its timing sits right next to it.

lines.text: There are two hundred and thirty-five of them, from quiet entrances to full theatrics. Whatever the moment needs already has a name.
lines.say: There are two hundred and thirty-five of them, from quiet entrances to full theatrics. Whatever the moment needs already has a name.

lines.text: When the effect you want doesn't exist, nobody opens a stylesheet. Describe the frames in the class; the keyframes are generated for you.
lines.say: When the effect you want doesn't exist, nobody opens a stylesheet. Describe the frames in the class; the keyframes are generated for you.

lines.text: Properties layer without fighting. Rotation on one rhythm, scale on another, each control scoped to its own slot.
lines.say: Properties layer without fighting. Rotation on one rhythm, scale on another, each control scoped to its own slot.

lines.text: Lists stagger with one class on the parent. The children take turns. No JavaScript counting indexes.
lines.say: Lists stagger with one class on the parent. The children take turns. No JavaScript counting indexes.

lines.text: And at runtime, it costs nothing. All of it compiles to plain CSS at build time, so the browser does the work.
lines.say: And at runtime, it costs nothing. All of it compiles to plain CSS at build time, so the browser does the work.

lines.text: Jumi is MIT-licensed and on npm. Static is just the start.
lines.say: Joomi is M I T licensed, and on N P M. Static is just the start.
